d: It is finally spooky season again, which means more jack-o-lanterns, ghost costumes, and creepy houses in the woods no one would dare enter! Don't you worry, though, as we traveled deep into the forest to record a thunderstorm at this creepy treehouse so you could experience it from the safety of your home. Listening to the thunder and rain sound for sleeping is perfect for helping you relax, especially if the Halloween season has you on edge.
